title: Campus Cards, Set 02: Berkeley
dek: Twelve more place cards: the campanile, the bronze gate, the creek under the footbridges, and the fog pouring in through the Golden Gate. Berkeley rides the same Tezos contract as Santa Barbara, so the collection is now twenty-four cards on one signature.
body:
Set 02 is Berkeley, drawn the same way as Santa Barbara: from the places, never from the logos.

Sather Tower is the legendary, capped at five. Sather Gate and the view of the bay from the fire trails are rare, twenty-five each. The Sproul steps, the Greek Theatre, and Memorial Glade are uncommon, a hundred each. Strawberry Creek, the eucalyptus grove, Telegraph Avenue, the BART station under Shattuck, the Tilden carousel, and the fog at the Gate are common and open.

The mainnet contract was never originated, so there was no reason to bolt Berkeley on afterward. It now registers both sets at birth: Santa Barbara is tokens 0 through 11, Berkeley is 12 through 23, and any campus after this one arrives through the same contract, closed until it is ready. A fresh Shadownet copy minted the Berkeley legendary and three fogs, and the indexer agreed.

The cards still say unofficial on every face. What's left is unchanged and is Mike's: pin, sign in Kukai, unpause. Davis is next in the queue.
